paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: Evaluation of our models and LLaMA-3-8B-inst.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of scores obtained by various language models across different datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis, labeled “Dataset and Metrics,” displays a series of categorical labels representing the evaluated models, including eSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench, and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents the score, expressed as a percentage, and ranges from 0 to 80. The scale is linear, with tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 10%, and the axis is labeled with corresponding percentage values. The bars are colored differently for each model: eSM-8K is depicted in blue and reaches a score of approximately 63%, LLaMA-3-8B-it is orange, reaching approximately 61%, "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" is also orange, reaching approximately 66%, MBPP is depicted in yellow and reaches approximately 48%, LC AlpacaEval-2 is also yellow and reaches approximately 42%, MT-Bench is depicted in red and reaches approximately 36%, and finally, the Chat-Arena-Hard bar is depicted in red and reaches approximately 34%. The bars appear to be sorted in descending order of score, with the eSM-8K bar being the tallest and the Chat-Arena-Hard bar the shortest.
